mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_artwork ( artwork_title, artwork_description, artwork_image, year_of_artwork, user_number, work_category_number, location ) VALUES ( #{artworkTitle}, #{artworkDescription}, #{artworkImage}, #{yearOfArtwork}, #{userNumber}, #{workCategoryNumber}, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{lng}, #{lat}), 4326) )
mapper.select: SELECT artwork_number, artwork_title, artwork_image, ST_Y(location::geometry) AS latitude, ST_X(location::geometry) AS longitude FROM tb_artwork WHERE ST_DWithin(location, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{lng}, #{lat}), 4326), #{radius})

SELECT artwork_number, artwork_title, artwork_description, artwork_image, year_of_artwork, user_number, work_category_number, ST_Y(location::geometry) AS latitude, ST_X(location::geometry) AS longitude FROM tb_artwork WHERE artwork_number = #{artworkNumber}
mapper.update:
UPDATE tb_artwork
artwork_title = #{artworkTitle}, artwork_description = #{artworkDescription}, artwork_image = #{artworkImage}, year_of_artwork = #{yearOfArtwork}, work_category_number = #{workCategoryNumber},
location = ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{lng}, #{lat}), 4326),
WHERE artwork_number = #{artworkNumber}
